''See also: [[Reading Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|Reading is a discipline involving the conscious observation and manipulation of [[Intent]], which is the energy or emotion embedded within physical objects and people. Practitioners, known as [[Readers]], use focused willpower to sense the history, purpose, or emotional echoes left behind by humans on items ranging from simple notes to weapons. This ability can manifest as clear visions of an object's past or merely vague sensory impressions. While most people use [[Intent]] subconsciously, [[Readers]] can actively engage with it to investigate crimes, uncover truths, or understand the history of artifacts. A specialized and rare form of this skill is [[Active Reading|active Reading]]. This process allows a Reader to physically alter or transform an object by twisting its [[Intent]], a technique similar to [[Awakening]]. While highly useful for tasks like escaping confinement or crafting tools, [[Active Reading|active Reading]] is mentally taxing and can lead to [[Reader burn]] if the practitioner's constitution cannot handle the strain. It is also described as a violent process that can easily result in destruction rather than controlled change. Reading carries significant social and psychological risks. Attempting to sense the [[Intent]] of a crowd can cause a Reader to lose themselves in the collective emotion, and attempting to read the minds of [[Elders]] directly can result in insanity. Because of their unique abilities, [[Readers]] often occupy high-status or specialized roles within [[The Empire|the Empire]], such as investigators or craftsmen, and they are frequently subject to intense scrutiny by organizations tasked with verifying their honesty. Furthermore, powerful [[Readers]] possess a level of autonomy that places them largely above the reach of standard legal enforcement.}}

== Of Sea and Shadow ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow|Reading is a specialized technique utilized by members of the [[Blackwatch]] that involves processing obscure information. [[Calder]] employs this method to focus his mind on specific objects and to sense his ship, which helps him strengthen his [[Intent]]. By applying the technique to the vessel, he can ensure that it accepts new additions. Beyond physical objects, [[Calder]] has used Reading on the aura of the [[Gray Island]] to witness certain events. Ultimately, [[Readers]] use this ability to perceive visions regarding an object's lifetime or its past creation.}}

== Of Shadow and Sea ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea|Reading is a specialized training discipline for [[Architects]] that requires the practitioner to maintain emotional empathy and openness. This technique allows individuals like [[Lucan]] to perceive the history contained within various objects. It serves several practical functions, such as investing items like [[Tristania]]'s coat to provide protection against bullets. Additionally, the power is potentially utilized to maintain the structural integrity of the [[Council of Architects]]' ceiling.}}

== Of Dawn and Darkness ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness|Reading is a process experienced by [[Calder]], who utilizes the ability as an extended sense. To maintain [[The Testament]] and communicate with the [[Lyathatan]], [[Calder]] must engage in constant Reading. He applies this technique to [[Imperial relics]] and uses it to activate the [[Optasia]]. Furthermore, the [[Gardener]] employs Reading by pressing palms against stone tiles to temporarily [[Awaken]] the stone. Ultimately, the technique functions as a method that can flood the mind with [[Intent]].}}

== Of Darkness and Dawn ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn|Reading is a technique used to observe or understand things by perceiving the feelings of others and seeing into human history and intent. This power can even be applied to sense the intent of a specific location, a skill [[Lucan]] utilizes. While [[Ach'magut]] provided the education necessary to advance this ability, the Emperor leveraged that same knowledge to [[construct]] an empire. Although [[Darius Allbright|Darius]] performed a brief Reading, the practice carries extreme danger; attempting to read [[Elders]] directly is a great taboo that risks insanity from facing alien minds. Ultimately, the process of Reading came to an end for [[Shera]].}}

<div class="wv-facts mw-collapsible mw-collapsed"><div class="wv-facts-head mw-collapsible-toggle">Sourced facts <span class="wv-facts-count">10</span></div>

== Of Kings and Killers ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|[[Estyr]] plans to utilize the technique of Reading to uncover the truth from [[Calder]], who possesses this very ability. This method allows a practitioner to sense the ambient [[Intent]] within their surroundings and can be further amplified through the use of a device. While first generation [[Readers]] were able to understand foreign languages by interpreting the [[Intent]] behind words, the practice carries significant risks. Attempting to use Reading directly on [[Great Elders]] can result in a descent into asylum.}}

<div class="wv-facts mw-collapsible mw-collapsed"><div class="wv-facts-head mw-collapsible-toggle">Sourced facts <span class="wv-facts-count">6</span></div>

<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|[[Reading]] can be used to sense ambient [[Intent]] in surroundings.<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c8">''Of Kings and Killers'', chapter 8</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|[[Reading]] is a technique that can be amplified by a device.<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c11">''Of Kings and Killers'', chapter 11</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|First generation [[Readers]] could use [[Reading]] to understand other languages by reading the [[Intent]] behind words.<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c11" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|[[Calder]] has the ability of [[Reading]].<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c14">''Of Kings and Killers'', chapter 14</ref>}}</li>

</ul></div>

== Of Killers and Kings ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|Reading serves as a method for observing and understanding the fundamental nature of various elements, including the wind, the ground, or even human hearts. While this technique can be used by Witnesses to inspect individuals, it is noted that intent does not easily cling to liquid. Beyond simple observation, the practice functions as a way to detect traps or can even be employed as a weapon. [[Loreli]] utilizes this skill to sense the air surrounding her.}}

<div class="wv-facts mw-collapsible mw-collapsed"><div class="wv-facts-head mw-collapsible-toggle">Sourced facts <span class="wv-facts-count">5</span></div>
<ul class="wv-fact-list mw-collapsible-content">

<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|[[Intent]] does not easily cling to liquid.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c4">''Of Killers and Kings'', chapter 4</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|Witnesses use [[Reading]] to inspect people.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c6">''Of Killers and Kings'', chapter 6</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|[[Reading]] is a technique that can be used to detect traps or as a weapon.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c15">''Of Killers and Kings'', chapter 15</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|[[Loreli]] uses [[Reading]] to sense the air around her.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c24">''Of Killers and Kings'', chapter 24</ref>}}</li>
</ul></div>
